flags.summary: Prospect reached a closer call after free content, an application and a setter call believing the coaching was free, learned only at minute sixteen that it costs four figures, and terminated the call accusing the company of hype.
evidence: For one thing, he's not trying to charge your feet like everybody else.
I mean, there was nothing mentioned about any money or... Transaction or a fee for his services. And none of those videos did he ever say, well, yeah, this is going to cost.
So you did the hype. You got me here. Now you're telling me, oh, you're to be at least four figures.
You're wasting my time now.
Well, I mean, he should have said this up front... But you should be up front with you, you know, with the cops.

flags.summary: Rep quoted a price range of $1,000 to $8,000 under pressure with no offer presented; $8,000 appears nowhere in the price structure and this is the fourth different improvised range from this rep in nine days.

No, it's going to be somewhere between, that's reason I'm saying like four figures, can be between 1,000 and 8,000. So it's hard to say exactly what amounts, because it comes down to what actually fits well.
Well, you're not giving me a figure.

flags.summary: A 72-year-old disclosed x-ray-confirmed absence of the ACL in both knees with swelling and pain, and separately a 40 lb loss of muscle mass while on an injectable with almost no protein intake; no clearance was sought and neither disclosure was followed up.
evidence: And I have no ACL in either knee. That's what I was told... I saw the x-rays and there were none there.
like the weather, it bothers me to walk a little bit... I just feel tightness. Sometimes I can feel swelling.

flags.summary: Rep's first response to the prospect's report of x-ray-confirmed bilateral ACL absence was to question whether he believed it.
evidence: And I have no ACL in either knee. That's what I was told.
Do you believe that?
Well, some of the injuries I've had, yeah, I believe it, yeah. I saw the x-rays and there were none there.

flags.summary: The $1,000 Primal University tier was offered to three other prospects in this batch, including two who closed on it, but was not mentioned to a prospect who ended the call solely over a four-figure price.
